scope: Harvest-target update notice and guide only; no fluent review claimed. No lesson or quiz changes.

entries.source: Set weekly harvest targets and review growing space, dated sowings and gaps.

drafts.zu: Beka imigomo yesivuno samasonto onke bese ubuyekeza indawo yokutshala, izinsuku zokuhlwanyela nezikhala.
drafts.st: Beha dipheo tsa kotulo tsa beke le beke mme o hlahlobe sebaka sa temo, dinako tsa ho jala le dikgeo.
drafts.ts: Veka swikongomelo swa ntshovelo wa vhiki na vhiki kutani u kambisisa ndhawu yo byala, masiku yo byala ni swikhala.
drafts.ve: Vheani zwipikwa zwa khaṋo ya vhege iṅwe na iṅwe ni ṱole fhethu ha u ṱavha, zwifhinga zwa u zwala na zwikhala.

drafts.st: Rala ho ya ka sepheo sa kotulo
drafts.ve: Pulana u bva kha tshipikwa tsha khaṋo

drafts.st: Moralo wa dijalo → Dipheo tsa kotulo
drafts.ts: Mukungu wa swibyariwa → Swikongomelo swa ntshovelo
drafts.ve: Mupulani wa zwiliṅwa → Zwipikwa zwa khaṋo

entries.source: Choose a crop, weekly weight and harvest months. Review the proposal before adding its dated sowings to your crop plan.

drafts.zu: Khetha isitshalo, isisindo samasonto onke nezinyanga zokuvuna. Buyekeza isiphakamiso ngaphambi kokwengeza ukuhlwanyela okunezinsuku ohlelweni lwakho lwezitshalo.
drafts.st: Kgetha sejalo, boima ba beke le beke le dikgwedi tsa kotulo. Hlahloba tlhahiso pele o eketsa dinako tsa ho jala moralong wa hao wa dijalo.
drafts.ts: Hlawula xibyariwa, ntiko wa vhiki na vhiki ni tin’hweti ta ntshovelo. Kambisisa xiringanyeto u nga si engetela masiku ya xona yo byala eka kungu ra wena ra swibyariwa.
drafts.ve: Nangani tshiliṅwa, tshileme tsha vhege iṅwe na iṅwe na miṅwedzi ya khaṋo. Ṱolani nyeletshedzo ni sa athu u engedza zwifhinga zwayo zwa u zwala kha pulane yaṋu ya zwiliṅwa.
